fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance to help responders locate the property quickly from the road.
• Mark the single driveway entrance clearly on both sides so responders can identify it without slowing to search.
• Clear vegetation along both sides of the access drive to allow full-width vehicle passage without obstruction.
• Trim any tree branches overhanging the access drive to a height that allows ladder trucks and tall emergency vehicles to pass without stopping.
• Create a designated turnaround area near the main residence large enough for a fire engine or ambulance to reverse direction without backing the full length of the drive.
• Keep the turnaround area clear of parked vehicles, equipment, and stored materials at all times.
• Mark the edge of the water feature with clearly visible posts or markers so responders moving on foot or in vehicles in low-light conditions can identify the drop-off.
• Cut back dense vegetation between the detached structure and the main residence so responders can move between the two buildings on foot without obstruction.
• Mark any foot path connecting the main residence to the detached structure so responders can navigate between structures quickly.
• Post the property address visibly at the road and again at the point where the access drive reaches the main residence.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Remove woody debris piles from areas near the house and any outbuildings.
• Trim tree branches and shrubs that are touching or directly next to the house walls.
• Thin trees within the cluster closest to the structure to create open gaps between them.
• Separate shrubs from one another near the house so they are not connected by continuous plant growth.
• Cut grass around the house and near other structures short, especially during dry months.
• Clear overhanging branches and shrubs along both sides of the driveway so vehicles can pass without obstruction.
• Trim branches that hang over the driveway to allow full vehicle clearance from edge to edge.
• Remove dead branches, fallen limbs, and leaf litter from beneath trees near the house.
• Thin scattered shrubs near the structure so there is open ground between individual plants and the building.
• Keep the area between the tree cluster and the house as open as possible by removing low-hanging limbs and shrubs in that space.
• Clear woody debris and dead plant material from the edges of the water feature if it is close to any structure.
• Keep the single driveway access route free of overgrown vegetation at all times so emergency vehicles can reach the property without delay.
